data.name: Us or Them
data.detailed_description:
Us or Them is an asymmetrical horror extraction game for expeditions of up to 26 players. Raid cursed lands for resources and treasures before nightfall, reach the ship, and survive.

Most players begin each expedition as Explorers, but one player starts as a brutal Monster stalking the group from the shadows. When an Explorer dies, they change sides and return as a Lesser form of the Monster, turning former allies into new threats and making every death more dangerous for those left behind.

Work together, gather resources, and escape with your rewards!

WORK TOGETHER OR FALL APART

Explorers must rely on each other to search the environment, carry valuables, light the way with lanterns, and get their findings back to safety. Staying together improves your odds, but fear, greed, and panic can tear even the best expedition apart.

BECOME THE MONSTER

Hunt your friends as a relentless Monster. Use speed, ambush tactics, and pressure to isolate Explorers, break their formation, and turn their mistakes against them.

Every Explorer you kill returns as a Lesser Monster, creating a deadly chain reaction where the expedition becomes more dangerous with every casualty. Self preservation is key, but altruism will increase your odds of success.

BURNING DAYLIGHT

Each expedition changes as the sun rises or sets. Nightfall makes the world far more dangerous for Explorers trying to search, navigate, and escape.

Use lanterns, teamwork, and haste to survive the dark, or get the job done before the daylight is gone.

SURVIVE THE EXPEDITION

Monsters can watch from afar, ambush stragglers, and overwhelm isolated players. The more Explorers fall, the more Monsters are drawn to the madness.

Every expedition offers rewards, but only those who make it out alive get to keep what they found.

FEATURES

  • Up to 26-player asymmetrical PvP multiplayer horror

  • Explorer teamwork, looting, hauling, and extraction

  • Playable Monster role focused on hunting, ambushes, and pressure

  • Fallen Explorers return as Lesser Monsters

  • Escalating matches where every death makes survival harder

  • Day-to-night expedition pressure

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD RX 580 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / 3060 or AMD RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
